name: raildock-web
description: RailDock website: marketing, documentation and API reference served as one RailDock service.

scripts.build: npm run build:docs && npm run build:api
scripts.build:api: npm run sync:openapi && npm --prefix api-reference run build
scripts.validate: python3 validate.py && node --check marketing/assets/site.js && node --check api-reference/src/main.js && node --check server.mjs
